partner_result.scope_applied: fixed-interval bathtub extremization to unit-measure indicator marginals and finite-fragment approximation

new_result.name: global convex-mixture localization
new_result.statement: Every admissible one-dimensional density is an L1 limit of finite convex combinations of compact finite-union unit-set indicators; therefore every admissible product law, and its pushforward under any measurable map, is in TV closure of finite convex mixtures of extreme product laws. For Q=x^T A x this preserves the exact optimal small-ball/L-infinity constant.

key_proof_mechanism: cap-preserving compactification without moments or renormalization
mass-preserving grid conditional expectation on cells of length 1/N
finite hypersimplex decomposition into 0-1 vectors with exactly N ones
product L1 telescoping and pushforward TV contraction
unresolved_implication: Prove a universal small-ball bound on compact finite-fragment indicator products uniformly in component count, locations, separations, grid scale and support diameter.
next_step: Use the law-level mixture reduction only with estimates uniform in all localization parameters; do not impose a fixed fragment count or diameter.
